info.title: Inventory Flow Shared Read API
info.description: Deployment pending live verification. Provisional hostname. Backend-only authenticated REST API for authorized selected-release public inventory, typed changes, non-private vehicle facts and hold aggregates. No writes, customer/private CRM fields, archived snapshot query or complete CRM-only inventory API. MCP is separately exposed at /mcp using its configured managed OAuth identity flow, not this Bearer app-key contract.

servers.description: Provisional production endpoint — deployment/credentials must be confirmed by the operator.

get.summary: Search and page through the selected verified inventory release
get.description: Read only. Requires inventory.read. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Responses are private and must not be publicly cached.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal partial search of safe projected values. Model punctuation, formatted numbers and readable dates are folded; *, ?, ~ and | remain literal.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Public physical-store filter. Unassigned stores yield no rows, never expand access.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Exact case-insensitive, punctuation-folded make.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Exact case-insensitive, punctuation-folded model.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Exact model year.

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Published asking-price bound; unpriced records do not match.

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Published asking-price bound; unpriced records do not match.

parameters.name: minMileage
parameters.description: Published mileage bound; missing mileage does not match.

parameters.name: maxMileage
parameters.description: Published mileage bound; missing mileage does not match.

parameters.name: holdState
parameters.description: Conservative hold state, not availability.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field; missing values remain last.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; VIN is a deterministic tiebreaker.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows for this page; reduce if response exceeds 1 MiB.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque signed cursor from previous identical query. Restart from the first page on INVALID_CURSOR; never combine snapshots.

get.summary: Get one authorized VIN with the same rich facts as inventory
get.description: Read only. Requires inventory.read. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Responses are private and must not be publicly cached.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: Full VIN. Missing, invalid and unauthorized VINs produce the same not-found behavior.

get.summary: Read public change events stored with the selected release
get.description: Read only. Requires changes.read. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Responses are private and must not be publicly cached.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal partial search of safe projected values. Model punctuation, formatted numbers and readable dates are folded; *, ?, ~ and | remain literal.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Public physical-store filter. Unassigned stores yield no rows, never expand access.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: One public change category.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive event report-date lower bound; does not retrieve archived snapshots.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive event report-date upper bound; must be on or after from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows for this page; reduce if response exceeds 1 MiB.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque signed cursor from previous identical query. Restart from the first page on INVALID_CURSOR; never combine snapshots.

get.summary: Read selected release freshness and authorized visible-row count
get.description: Read only. Requires health.read. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Responses are private and must not be publicly cached.

get.summary: Aggregate conservative hold signals for authorized public inventory
get.description: Read only. Requires holds.aggregate.read. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Responses are private and must not be publicly cached.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Public physical-store filter. Unassigned stores yield no rows, never expand access.

get.summary: List manager-log sold and delivered evidence for authorized inventory
get.description: Read only. Requires inventory.read. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Manager-log evidence is independent of public listing status, DealerMail hold state, CDK evidence and physical location; absence of a row is not evidence that a vehicle is unsold, available or undelivered. Responses are private and must not be publicly cached.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text filter over published identity fields only.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Filters on physical store when known, otherwise the reporting source store. Unassigned stores yield no rows, never expand access.

parameters.name: delivered
parameters.description: Sent as the string "true" or "false"; any other value is rejected.

parameters.name: review
parameters.description: Limits to rows whose match needs human review. Sent as the string "true" or "false".

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque signed cursor from a prior page. Invalid or stale cursors are rejected with INVALID_CURSOR.

get.summary: Discover granted scopes, stores and supported capabilities
get.description: Read only. Requires an active authenticated integration grant. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Responses are private and must not be publicly cached.

BearerAppKey.description: A per-application server-side integration key. Send only in Authorization. Never use in query parameters, browser bundles, AI prompts or public storage. Scopes and stores are enforced by the server grant.

Hold.description: No current hold found is not an availability determination. Stale/incomplete source states return null current-hold and backup metrics.

Location.description: Store-level location only; no custodian, driver, transfer ID, notes, or customer outcomes.

AutoCheck.description: Parsed VIN-specific facts only; original report content and authenticated report URLs are not returned.

FactoryEquipment.description: Informational VIN-specific equipment labels remain distinct from original Monroney window stickers.

managerDisposition.description: Null when no manager log covers this vehicle, which is not evidence that it is unsold or undelivered.

Vehicle.description: Explicit bounded read model for authorized public VINs. Missing values are null, not inferred zero/false. Original MSRP currency must be read from its associated sticker facts.

coverage.const: Publicly listed vehicles only; not all CRM inventory

WorkerVersion.description: Cloudflare version metadata of the Worker that answered, read from its version_metadata binding. Null when the binding is not configured (local development and tests). Identifies the deployed code, never the freshness of the data it serves.

versionId.description: Cloudflare Worker version id, as listed by wrangler deployments list.

versionTag.description: Tag passed to wrangler deploy --tag; the repository deploy scripts use the source git short SHA.

versionTimestamp.description: When the version was created, as reported by Cloudflare.

ManagerDispositionCoverage.description: Which source stores supplied a manager log for this release. Absence of a row is not evidence of anything.

caveat.const: No row means no manager-log signal in a covered source, not unsold, available, or not delivered. Stores outside the covered source list have no manager-log coverage.

ManagerDisposition.description: Sold/delivered evidence re-derived from a manager-supplied log. Independent of public listing status, DealerMail hold state, CDK evidence and physical location; never infer one from another. Manager-log free text is excluded at the source.

deliveryDate.description: Null whenever the manager log does not mark the vehicle delivered.

sourceStore.description: Store whose manager log reported the row, which is not a physical-location claim.

statusIndependence.const: Sold and delivered manager-log evidence is shown separately from public listing, DealerMail hold, CDK, and physical-store fields.

BadRequest.description: Invalid/unknown query or cursor; INVALID_CURSOR requires a fresh listing.

Forbidden.description: Inactive grant, unapproved host, missing scope or denied permission.

NotFound.description: No authorized matching vehicle or endpoint.

TooLarge.description: Response exceeds the server byte limit; request a smaller page.

RateLimited.description: Per-integration quota exceeded. Honor Retry-After; do not retry immediately.

Unavailable.description: Verified data, authentication, audit, quota or required configuration unavailable. Fail closed.
